controls.name: range
controls.doc: The tracking range, in the order of the integer the kernel reads: low (a bass, 35 to 140 Hz), mid (70 to 280 Hz), high (140 to 560 Hz); each a row of SUBOCT_RANGE_LO_HZ, SUBOCT_RANGE_HI_HZ, SUBOCT_POST1_HZ and SUBOCT_POST2_HZ. Low comes up.

controls.name: oct1
controls.doc: The octave below, percent of the tracked band divided once (omx_divider) and low-passed at the range's post1.

controls.name: oct2
controls.doc: Two octaves below, percent: the first octave divided again and low-passed at the range's post2.

controls.name: dry
controls.doc: The input, percent. With both octaves at 0 and the dry at 100 the face is the input bit for bit, the divider still tracking.

controls.name: trackGateDb
controls.doc: The tracked band's level, dBFS of its peak envelope, under which the octaves fade out over SUBOCT_GATE_RAMP_MS and trackedHz reads 0.

readouts.name: trackedHz
readouts.doc: The fundamental the divider tracks, Hz: the rate over the samples between its last two toggles, one toggle an input period; 0 while gated.

SUBOCT_RANGE_LO_HZ.doc: Each range's lowest tracked fundamental, Hz; the tracking band's high-pass sits an octave under it.

SUBOCT_RANGE_HI_HZ.doc: Each range's highest tracked fundamental, Hz: the tracking band's low-pass.

SUBOCT_POST1_HZ.doc: Each range's low-pass on the first octave, Hz, 24 dB per octave.

SUBOCT_POST2_HZ.doc: Each range's low-pass on the second octave, Hz, 24 dB per octave.

SUBOCT_HYSTERESIS.doc: The arming threshold as a share of the tracked peak: a toggle needs a dip under -1/4 of the peak, which a fundamental-dominant note makes once a cycle and noise under half of it never makes.

SUBOCT_ENV_ATTACK_MS.doc: The tracked peak's attack, ms: within the first cycle of the highest tracked note.

SUBOCT_ENV_RELEASE_MS.doc: The tracked peak's release, ms: longer than the lowest tracked period, so the threshold does not sag between peaks.

SUBOCT_GATE_RAMP_MS.doc: How long the octaves take to fade out under the gate, or in over it, ms.
